title: Daily Stress Check-Ins
subtitle: How daily stress check-ins supports long-term resilience, health, and sustainable behavior.
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence from randomized controlled trials and observational studies supports the benefits of daily stress check-ins, particularly when combined with coping interventions. Emerging evidence supports the integration of physiological biofeedback alongside subjective assessments. Limitations include variable study quality and populations studied.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
